sql: SELECT * FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=6 ORDER BY avail_doy
SELECT cls, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa, COUNT(*) n FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC
SELECT cls, fished_date_doy, yt, anglers, yt*1.0/anglers as ypa FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','multi_day','three_quarter') ORDER BY fished_date_doy

SELECT cls, boat, COUNT(*) n, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, SUM(yt)*1.0/SUM(anglers) ypa FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND fished_date_doy>=18 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter') GROUP BY cls, boat ORDER BY ypa DESC LIMIT 20
